name: spider_costume_fuzz
description: The empty spider costume stuck flat to a cave ceiling, seen top-down: torso, felt abdomen and splayed felt legs entirely coated in soft off-white cotton-wool fuzz (bumpy cloud outlines, grey speckle, a few brown felt spots peeking through), dark empty collar hole with the black bead eyes still showing, pale spray halo. No Doug, no gore. Anchor centre, ~500x420.
